definitions.gloss: composure; calmness; poise; presence of mind
definitions.explanation: A state of being calm and collected, especially in stressful situations.
A state of being settled or steady, often referring to living situations or life circumstances.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{落|お}ち{着|つ}きがあるので、{緊急|きんきゅう}{時|じ}に{頼|たよ}りになる。
examples.english: He has composure, so he's reliable in emergencies.

examples.japanese: この{子|こ}は{落|お}ち{着|つ}きがなくて、じっとしていられない。
examples.english: This child has no composure and can't sit still.
examples.notes: {落|お}ち{着|つ}きがない = restless, fidgety

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{地震|じしん}のあとも{落|お}ち{着|つ}きを{失|うしな}わず、{周|まわ}りの{人|ひと}を{冷静|れいせい}に{誘導|ゆうどう}した。
examples.english: Even after the big earthquake, he didn't lose his composure and calmly guided the people around him.

examples.japanese: {転職|てんしょく}して{一年|いちねん}、ようやく{生活|せいかつ}に{落|お}ち{着|つ}きが{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: A year after changing jobs, my life is finally becoming stable.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しばかりで{落|お}ち{着|つ}きのない{生活|せいかつ}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: I keep moving, and my unsettled lifestyle continues.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもが{生|う}まれてからようやく{家庭|かてい}に{落|お}ち{着|つ}きが{出|で}て、{週末|しゅうまつ}は{家族|かぞく}で{過|す}ごすことが{多|おお}くなった。
examples.english: After the child was born, the household finally settled down, and we started spending more weekends together as a family.

notes:
FORMS:
{落|お}ち{着|つ}く (to calm down, to settle) → {落|お}ち{着|つ}き (noun form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {落|お}ち{着|つ}きがある - to have composure
- {落|お}ち{着|つ}きがない - to lack composure, restless
- {落|お}ち{着|つ}きを{取|と}り{戻|もど}す - to regain composure
- {落|お}ち{着|つ}きを{払|はら}う - to stay calm
- {落|お}ち{着|つ}きのある{人|ひと} - a composed person

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {冷静|れいせい} - calm, cool-headed
- {沈着|ちんちゃく} - composure (literary)
- {平静|へいせい} - calmness, equanimity
